messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed persistent LB egress issues from rack7 hitting ToR-22. Internal L4 flows intermittently reset, and RDMA sessions are falling back to TCP. Repro across multiple GPU pods. :eyes:
kevin: seeing the same from test jobs. Prometheus shows tx_errors spike on tor-22 egress, and kube-proxy logs report `fragmentation required` (MSS issues).
ash: can you paste `ip -s link show` and `ethtool -S` from the leaf facing tor-22? curious about drops vs hw-checksum.
maria: paste below (short):
```
3: eth0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    RX: bytes 123456789 packets 987654 errors 124 dropped 0 overruns 0 frame 0
    TX: bytes 987654321 packets 123456 errors 128 dropped 0 overruns 0 carrier 0 collisions 0
```
kevin: errors in both RX/TX on leaf facing tor-22. that explains resets.
lia: I ran `rdma link` earlier — Port1 intermittently shows state DOWN for a few seconds then comes back. RDMA sessions go into fallback path to TCP.
sre-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created for intra-cluster LB/ToR degradation (pager notifications sent).
kevin: quick mitigation idea — shift LB pool for rack7 to tor-21 to stop flapping while we diagnose. can we do that without disrupting live jobs?
maria: I applied a temporary static route to prefer tor-21 for rack7 egress. traffic looks stable for ~5m but RDMA fallback logs continue.
nash: pasting kernel log excerpt: 
```
kernel: rcvd RDMACM: rdma_cm_event: CONNECT_ERROR - -22
kernel: tcp: dropping due to MTU: fragmentation required
```
ash: this smells like an MTU hole — maybe a firmware patch on tor-22 toggled jumbo frames or disabled offload.
lia: confirmed — tor-22 firmware recently rolled (auto-apply window). hardware team flagged change to `tx-hw-checksum` behavior in release notes.
maria: I'm starting live migration of 4 GPU pods off rack7 to reduce risk. ETA ~8m.
kevin: ops runbook for this: 1) rollback tor-22 firmware patch, 2) temporarily set MTU 9216 on leaf->ToR before re-enabling RDMA, 3) re-run connectivity tests and RDMA benchmarks, 4) slowly re-balance LB pools.
nash: I'll capture spine->tor-22 pcap during migration and check TCP MSS/DF flags and GRE headers.
lia: hardware team just confirmed rollback queued — ETA 12m.
maria: rollback done, tor-22 reports no tx_errors now. RDMA sessions started re-establishing.
kevin: verify with `rdma_hwstat` and `ibv_devinfo` that ports are back UP and no retries.
lia: running a quick RDMA iperf test between two GPUs — throughput back to baseline.
maria: monitoring for 30m before rebalancing LB pool and moving pods back.
deploy-bot: note: rolling LB pool change scheduled at 2026-03-18T12:42:00Z (manual approve required).
kevin: postmortem action items: add pre/post firmware test for MTU/offload toggles, automated smoke test for RDMA sessions after ToR changes, and a playbook to failover LB pools per-rack.
maria: thanks all — will keep an eye and close thread if stable. :thumbsup:
